selection_policy.data_firewall: metadata-only selection; no source blobs, diffs, labels, tests, scores, smoke, or inference read by this selector
selection_policy.repositories: three distinct canonical public GitHub repositories under distinct owner namespaces, not used by the prior v1/v2 sample or adapter corpus
selection_policy.sample_kind: purposive fixed set; not random or population-representative
selection_policy.tag_rule: resolve every matching annotated or lightweight tag to its commit; use committer timestamp; choose latest commit timestamp not later than each anchor; ties: greatest numeric version tuple, then tag, then commit ID
